title: Application of Blackstone Gas Company, pursuant to G.L. c. 164 App., §§ 2-1 through 2-10 and 220 C.M.R. §§ 7.00 et seq. for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of the Company's proposed surcharge for the Residential Energy Conservation Service Program for fiscal year 1998 (July 1, 1997 through June 30, 1998). Blackstone Gas Company is a member utility of Mass-Save, Inc., which provides service on its behalf.
